ET.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled total evapotranspiration -- water evaporated from soil/canopy plus transpired by plants.

T2m.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled air temperature at 2 meters above the surface.

TD2m.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled dewpoint temperature at 2 meters above the surface (a measure of atmospheric moisture).

TRANSP.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled transpiration -- water released to the atmosphere by plants.

VPD.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled vapor pressure deficit -- how much drier the air is than saturated (higher = greater atmospheric pulling power on moisture).

ET.glossary: Mosaic land-surface-model evapotranspiration -- water evaporated from soil/canopy plus transpired by plants.
Noah land-surface-model evapotranspiration -- water evaporated from soil/canopy plus transpired by plants.
VIC land-surface-model evapotranspiration -- water evaporated from soil/canopy plus transpired by plants.

VPDMAX.glossary: PRISM daily maximum vapor pressure deficit -- how much drier the air gets than saturated at its driest point in the day.

VPDMIN.glossary: PRISM daily minimum vapor pressure deficit -- how much drier the air is than saturated at its most humid point in the day.

ET.glossary: Satellite-driven evapotranspiration -- water evaporated from soil/canopy plus transpired by plants.
Satellite-driven evapotranspiration -- water evaporated from soil/canopy plus transpired by plants.

RUNOFF.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled surface and subsurface runoff -- water leaving the land as streamflow.

SUBSURFACE_RUNOFF.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled subsurface runoff -- the slower base-flow/groundwater-recharge component of total runoff.

SURFACE_RUNOFF.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled fast overland-flow runoff -- the storm/melt-event component of total runoff.

Precipitation.glossary: Global Precipitation Climatology Project satellite/gauge-blended total precipitation.

RUNOFF.glossary: Mosaic land-surface-model runoff -- water leaving the land as streamflow.
Noah land-surface-model runoff -- water leaving the land as streamflow.
VIC land-surface-model runoff -- water leaving the land as streamflow.

ROOT_SM.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled root-zone soil moisture -- water content in the soil layers plant roots draw from.

SURFACE_SM.glossary: Reanalysis-modeled surface soil moisture -- water content in the top soil layer.

TWSA.glossary: Satellite gravity-derived total water storage anomaly -- the combined change in groundwater, soil moisture, snow, and surface water.

GWS.glossary: Model-assimilated groundwater storage percentile, derived from GRACE satellite gravity data.

RTZSM.glossary: Model-assimilated root-zone soil moisture percentile, derived from GRACE satellite gravity data.

SFSM.glossary: Model-assimilated surface soil moisture percentile, derived from GRACE satellite gravity data.

GPP.glossary: Simple Biosphere Model gross primary productivity -- total carbon captured by photosynthesis.

NEE.glossary: Simple Biosphere Model net ecosystem exchange -- the balance of carbon uptake (photosynthesis) and release (respiration); negative means the land is a net carbon sink.

RECO.glossary: Simple Biosphere Model ecosystem respiration -- total carbon released back to the atmosphere by plants and soil microbes.

EVI.glossary: Enhanced Vegetation Index -- a satellite greenness index that corrects for canopy background and atmospheric effects.

NDVI.glossary: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index -- a satellite greenness index sensitive to chlorophyll content.

SIF.glossary: Satellite-retrieved solar-induced fluorescence -- a faint light signal re-emitted during photosynthesis, used as a proxy for plant productivity.
Satellite-retrieved solar-induced fluorescence -- a faint light signal re-emitted during photosynthesis, used as a proxy for plant productivity.

GCC.glossary: Green chromatic coordinate -- canopy greenness measured from repeat digital-camera imagery, a proxy for vegetation phenology.

NEE.glossary: Tower-measured net ecosystem exchange -- the balance of carbon uptake (photosynthesis) and release (respiration) at a single eddy-covariance site.
Atmospheric-inversion-optimized net ecosystem exchange -- the balance of carbon uptake and release by the land surface.

SIF.glossary: Satellite-derived (OCO-2-based, gap-filled) solar-induced fluorescence -- a photosynthesis proxy.

GPP.glossary: Gross primary productivity derived from GOSIF solar-induced fluorescence.

NEE.glossary: Modular integrated CASA model net ecosystem exchange -- the balance of carbon uptake and release by the land surface.

NPP.glossary: Modular integrated CASA model net primary productivity -- carbon captured by photosynthesis minus the plant's own respiration.

RH.glossary: Modular integrated CASA model heterotrophic respiration -- carbon released to the atmosphere by soil microbial decomposition.

EVI.glossary: Enhanced Vegetation Index -- a satellite greenness index that corrects for canopy background and atmospheric effects.

GPP.glossary: Satellite-driven gross primary productivity -- total carbon captured by photosynthesis.

LAI.glossary: Satellite-derived leaf area index -- the area of leaf surface per unit ground area, a measure of canopy density.

LSWI.glossary: Land Surface Water Index -- satellite-derived index of canopy/leaf water content.

NDVI.glossary: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index -- a satellite greenness index sensitive to chlorophyll content.

EVI.glossary: Enhanced Vegetation Index -- a satellite greenness index that corrects for canopy background and atmospheric effects.

GPP.glossary: Satellite-driven gross primary productivity -- total carbon captured by photosynthesis.

LAI.glossary: Satellite-derived leaf area index -- the area of leaf surface per unit ground area, a measure of canopy density.

LSWI.glossary: Land Surface Water Index -- satellite-derived index of canopy/leaf water content.

NDVI.glossary: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index -- a satellite greenness index sensitive to chlorophyll content.

CARBON_EMISSIONS.glossary: Satellite-derived monthly carbon emissions from fire.

BI.glossary: Burning Index -- a fire-danger rating combining fuel and weather conditions into a relative measure of potential fire intensity.

ERC.glossary: Energy Release Component -- a fire-danger rating estimating the potential energy released per unit area if a fire were to occur.

FM100.glossary: 100-hour dead fuel moisture -- the moisture content of dead fuels roughly 1-3 inches thick.

FM1000.glossary: 1000-hour dead fuel moisture -- the moisture content of dead fuels roughly 3-8 inches thick.

FIRE.glossary: Modular integrated CASA model fire carbon emission -- carbon released to the atmosphere by biomass burning.

SPI-03.glossary: Standardized Precipitation Index: precipitation total over the trailing 3 months, expressed as a standardized departure from the long-term distribution.

SPI-06.glossary: Standardized Precipitation Index: precipitation total over the trailing 6 months, expressed as a standardized departure from the long-term distribution.

SPI-12.glossary: Standardized Precipitation Index: precipitation total over the trailing 12 months, expressed as a standardized departure from the long-term distribution.

SPEI-03.glossary: Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index: precipitation minus reference evapotranspiration over the trailing 3 months, standardized.

SPEI-06.glossary: Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index: precipitation minus reference evapotranspiration over the trailing 6 months, standardized.

SPEI-12.glossary: Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index: precipitation minus reference evapotranspiration over the trailing 12 months, standardized.

EDDI-03.glossary: Evaporative Demand Drought Index: standardized anomaly in atmospheric evaporative demand over the trailing 3 months (higher = drier air pulling more moisture from the land).

EDDI-06.glossary: Evaporative Demand Drought Index: standardized anomaly in atmospheric evaporative demand over the trailing 6 months (higher = drier air pulling more moisture from the land).

EDDI-12.glossary: Evaporative Demand Drought Index: standardized anomaly in atmospheric evaporative demand over the trailing 12 months (higher = drier air pulling more moisture from the land).

PDSI.glossary: Palmer Drought Severity Index: a soil-water-balance-based drought index computed from precipitation and evapotranspiration.

ForDRI.glossary: Forest Drought Response Index: a composite index combining vegetation health, climate, and soil-moisture signals into one weekly drought indicator for forested land.

ESI-12WK.glossary: Evaporative Stress Index: standardized anomaly in the ratio of actual to potential evapotranspiration over the trailing 12 weeks (low = plants under water stress).

ESI-4WK.glossary: Evaporative Stress Index: standardized anomaly in the ratio of actual to potential evapotranspiration over the trailing 4 weeks (low = plants under water stress).

USDM.glossary: U.S. Drought Monitor: weekly composite drought classification (D0-D4) blending multiple indices with local expert input.

value_type_glossary.sigma: Standardized anomaly: the value's percentile within its own baseline distribution, expressed as a standard-normal quantile -- not a classical mean/standard-deviation z-score, so it stays meaningful for skewed or bounded climatologies (e.g. precipitation, burned area).
value_type_glossary.percentile: The value's percentile within its own baseline distribution -- e.g. the 10th percentile means only 10% of baseline years were lower.
value_type_glossary.raw: The value itself, in its native physical units.
value_type_glossary.percent_of_normal: The value expressed as a percentage of its own calendar-month baseline mean (100% = exactly average).

GFED4.1s.label: GFED4.1s (legacy, 1997-2015)
GFED4.1s.note: Discontinued legacy fire product kept for historical context only -- not used for current-year drought detection; GFED5 is the pipeline's canonical fire product.

BURNED_AREA.label: Burned area
BURNED_AREA.glossary: Satellite-derived monthly burned area (GFED4.1s, 1997-2015 -- a discontinued legacy product kept for historical context; GFED5 is the pipeline's current fire product).

CARBON_EMISSIONS.label: Fire carbon emissions
CARBON_EMISSIONS.glossary: Satellite-derived monthly carbon emissions from fire (GFED4.1s, 1997-2015 -- a discontinued legacy product kept for historical context; GFED5 is the pipeline's current fire product).

GBBEPx.label: GBBEPx (near-real-time, 2024-05 onward)
GBBEPx.note: Raw near-real-time biomass-burning emissions -- record too short for a calendar-month baseline, so no anomaly is computed; GFED5 is the pipeline's canonical fire product.

BC_EMIS.label: Black carbon emissions
BC_EMIS.glossary: NOAA blended biomass-burning black carbon emissions (GBBEPx v5r0, 2024-05 onward -- record too short for a calendar-month baseline, shown as a raw near-real-time value).

CO2_EMIS.label: CO2 emissions
CO2_EMIS.glossary: NOAA blended biomass-burning CO2 emissions (GBBEPx v5r0, 2024-05 onward -- record too short for a calendar-month baseline, shown as a raw near-real-time value).

CO_EMIS.label: CO emissions
CO_EMIS.glossary: NOAA blended biomass-burning CO emissions (GBBEPx v5r0, 2024-05 onward -- record too short for a calendar-month baseline, shown as a raw near-real-time value).

OC_EMIS.label: Organic carbon emissions
OC_EMIS.glossary: NOAA blended biomass-burning organic carbon emissions (GBBEPx v5r0, 2024-05 onward -- record too short for a calendar-month baseline, shown as a raw near-real-time value).

PM25_EMIS.label: PM2.5 emissions
PM25_EMIS.glossary: NOAA blended biomass-burning PM2.5 emissions (GBBEPx v5r0, 2024-05 onward -- record too short for a calendar-month baseline, shown as a raw near-real-time value).
